## What's new: start a map from your agent, and know what a material is used by

- **"Make me a new zombies map."** Your agent can now create a map or mod from the mod tools' own templates, as the Launcher's File > New does: the `.map`, scripts, zone and sound config, ready to open in Radiant and build. It shows what it will create first, never overwrites a file, and keeps your stock overrides: the ZM Advanced template's copies of the stock assetlists are merged into yours instead of replacing them. Also `t7kb create <name>`.
- **Before renaming or deleting a material, see every model that uses it.** `gdt_refs` now reads each model's LOD files, where its materials really are, and the entries of `skinOverride`: a stock skybox material went from 0 references found to 451.
- **Building a mod works.** `t7kb build --mod` now links each of the mod's zones, as the Launcher does. A link whose only complaints are warnings (bad bullet meshes) is reported as the success it is, and a heavy first link gets an hour instead of 20 minutes.
- **Keep your mod-tools folder in git.** `/t7kb:setup` offers to version the BO3 root with ready-made ignore and LFS rules, so an assetlist edit, a GDT change or a pack install can be reviewed and undone.
